title: A Study to Assess the Long-Term Efficacy and Safety of Afimkibart (RO7790121) in Patients with Atopic Dermatitis who participated in previous Afimkibart Clinical Trials
official: An Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Afimkibart (RO7790121) in Patients with Atopic Dermatitis who Participated in Previous Afimkibart Clinical Trials
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of afimkibart
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Ability and willingness to comply with all aspects of the protocol including completion of the efficacy assessments (EASI and IGA), clinical outcome assessment instruments (DLQI, POEM), and safety and PK sample collections for the duration of the study
2. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements
3. Completed the treatment period of the parent study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Evidence of other skin conditions that would interfere with the assessment of AD, including, but not limited to, for example cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, allergic contact dermatitis
2. Withdrawal of consent and/or premature discontinuation from parent study
3. Any permanent discontinuation of study drug in parent study
4. Use of a prohibited therapy during the parent study
5. Investigator determination that treatment discontinuation is in the best interest of the participant
6. History of severe allergic reaction or anaphylactic reaction to any biologic agent or known hypersensitivity to any component of afimkibart
